data.title: Strive CEO Says Bitcoin Could ‘Go To A Penny’ And The Company Would Still Survive Because It Has No Debt
data.description: Strive Inc. (ASST) CEO Matt Cole said that Bitcoin (BTC) “could literally go to a penny,” and the treasury company would still survive because it carries no debt that could force it to sell.Speaking with Anthony Pompliano on the Pomp Podcast on Thursday, Cole explained that Strive raises money only…
